**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The renewal package sits at (in places above) our preferred position:

- **§ 8.2 — renewal term and exit:** successive **twelve-month** renewals, Customer opt-out on just **thirty days'** written notice, plus a **sixty-day** Vendor reminder obligation. The reminder even carries a self-help remedy — failure to send it extends Customer's opt-out deadline to thirty days after actual receipt — which is stronger than our preferred drafting.
- **§ 8.3 — price predictability:** uplift capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, matching our preferred cap and comfortably inside the 5% fallback, with ninety days' advance notice and no increase applied to prepaid periods.
- **§ 8.1 — three-year initial term:** this is the master agreement term, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so the walk-away test (multi-year auto-renewals / >90-day notice windows) is not triggered.

No material term fails either the preferred or fallback position, so per the playbook this clause is accepted as drafted.
